memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: fatigue and skin plaques.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: She reports 2‑month history of easy fatigue, occasional tingling in feet, and mild erythematous scaly plaques on elbows and knees.
EXAMINATION: BP 118/76 mmHg, pulse 78/min, weight 58 kg, height 1.60 m, BMI 22.7 (normal). Skin shows thin silvery plaques on extensor surfaces, no ulceration. Cardiovascular and respiratory exams normal.
IMPRESSION: Vitamin B12 deficiency likely contributing to fatigue; borderline hyperlipidaemia; chronic plaque psoriasis.
ARRANGEMENTS: Start methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD, atorvastatin 10 mg HS, clobetasol 0.05% cream BD to plaques, calcipotriol ointment OD to plaques, methotrexate 7.5 mg once weekly with folic acid 5 mg OD. Advise on balanced diet and regular activity. Return if fever >39°C, worsening joint pain, unexplained bruising, or severe skin irritation.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: routine follow‑up and skin review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Fatigue much improved, occasional tingling resolved. Psoriasis plaques less erythematous, mild scaling persists.
EXAMINATION: BP 120/78 mmHg, weight 59 kg, height 1.60 m, BMI 23.1 (overweight). Skin shows faint pink plaques with minimal scale. No joint swelling.
IMPRESSION: Vitamin B12 repleted, lipids improved, psoriasis responding to topicals. Overweight per Asian cut‑off.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD. Switch to rosuvastatin 10 mg OD. Keep clobetasol BD and calcipotriol OD. Methotrexate 7.5 mg weekly with folic acid 5 mg OD. Advise diet reduced refined carbs, increase walking 30 min daily. Return if new joint pain, fever >39°C, sudden weight loss, or severe skin flare.

Reason for visit: review of lipid control and psoriasis; influenza vaccine.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: No new symptoms. Skin plaques mild, occasional itch after work.
EXAMINATION: BP 122/80 mmHg, weight 60 kg, height 1.60 m, BMI 23.4 (overweight). Skin shows faint pink patches, no thickening.
IMPRESSION: LDL at target, triglycerides borderline, psoriasis stable. Overweight persists.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue rosuvastatin 10 mg OD. Add fenofibrate 145 mg OD for triglycerides. Keep topical steroids and calcipotriol. Methotrexate unchanged. Influenza vaccine offered and given today 2025-10-02. Advise maintain weight <23 kg/m² via diet and activity. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or unexplained bleeding.

Reason for visit: winter check‑up, medication tolerance.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Reports mild muscle soreness after heavy lifting, no skin flare.
EXAMINATION: BP 124/82 mmHg, weight 61 kg, height 1.60 m, BMI 23.8 (overweight). Skin shows stable plaques, no new lesions.
IMPRESSION: Mild CK elevation possibly statin‑related; lipids well controlled; psoriasis stable.
ARRANGEMENTS: Hold fenofibrate, continue rosuvastatin 10 mg OD. Check CK in 4 weeks. Keep topicals and methotrexate. Advise hydration, gradual activity increase. Return if dark urine, severe muscle weakness, fever >39°C, or joint swelling.

Reason for visit: spring follow‑up, review of statin tolerance and psoriasis.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Muscle soreness resolved after stopping fenofibrate. Skin lesions minimal, occasional itch after sweating.
EXAMINATION: BP 122/80 mmHg, weight 60 kg, height 1.60 m, BMI 23.4 (overweight). Skin shows faint pink patches, no scaling.
IMPRESSION: CK normalized, lipids good, psoriasis well controlled. Overweight persists.
ARRANGEMENTS: Restart fenofibrate 145 mg OD with rosuvastatin 10 mg OD. Continue topicals and methotrexate. Advise maintain weight <23 kg/m², regular aerobic activity. Return if unexplained pain, fever >39°C, joint swelling, or severe skin irritation.
